description: Header file defining the PowerController class, which manages power states, deep sleep, reboot, and wakeup configurations for a device within the WPEFramework. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external dependencies related to power management.

classes.name: PowerController
classes.description: Manages device power states, deep sleep, reboot, and wakeup configurations, providing an interface for power management within the framework.

methods.name: SetPowerState
methods.description: Sets the device's power state based on key code and reason.

methods.name: GetPowerState
methods.description: Retrieves the current and previous power states.

methods.name: GetPowerStateBeforeReboot
methods.description: Retrieves the power state prior to reboot.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboots the device with specified requestor and reasons.

methods.name: SetDeepSleepTimer
methods.description: Sets a timer for deep sleep.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create PowerController instances with optional custom implementation.
